deliverables: A concise proof-based simplification, with any cancellation explicitly conditioned on the original expression being defined.
A domain statement for the original rational expression.
A comparison of the original and simplified expressions at all real inputs, including excluded inputs.
subquestions: Which real inputs make the original denominator zero?
What factorization of the numerator permits a conditional cancellation?
On which inputs does the resulting expression agree with the original one?
Does the simplified expression have a value at every real number where the original expression is undefined?
